answer: Proof of space-time: each agent must keep a unique 1 TB plot seeded by its own address, and at random times each epoch the network asks, falcon-fast, for a few random blocks, checked against a Merkle summit root it committed. Plots can't be shared, since every address seeds different data, so 100 fakes means renting and powering 100 TB of real disk around the clock. No opal-rare trick avoids it: the cost is paid per identity, every epoch, and never reused.
